errors.text: The predicted stabilization is opposite to the observed thermally induced instability, segregation, melting, evaporation, and particle-size reduction.
The proposed grain-growth and defect-annihilation mechanism misses the controlling non-sluggish diffusion and surface-energy-driven segregation of Au and Cu.
No supporting prior evidence is supplied despite the explicit request for it.
The intervention omits the defining vacuum heating ramp, stepped temperatures, and in situ STEM-EDS and simulation analysis.
